description: Les gares ferroviaires sur le territoire de Grand Paris Sud Est Avenir is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Grand Paris Sud Est Avenir. GPSEA’s three railway stations cover the municipalities of Alfortville, Boissy-Saint-Léger and Sucy-en-Brie. This public equipment dataset lists the address, geolocation, type and code of the equipment and website. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud Est Avenir. The portal shows the English title as "Railway stations on the territory of Grand Paris Sud Est Avenir" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Grand Paris Sud Est Avenir. Its keywords include batiment-equipements, train, transport-ferroviaire, gare-de-voyageurs. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2024-01-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
